subject: Life Sciences
topic: Gametogenesis, puberty and the menstrual cycle
topicAf: Gametogenese, puberteit en die menstruele siklus

items.explain: Sperm are made in the seminiferous tubules and stored in the epididymis.
items.explainAf: Sperme word in die saadbuisies gemaak en in die epididimis gestoor.

items.q: One primary oocyte that completes meiosis produces:
items.qAf: Een primêre oösiet wat meiose voltooi, produseer:
items.explain: Unequal division gives one large ovum and small polar bodies that degenerate.
items.explainAf: Ongelyke deling gee een groot ovum en klein poolliggaampies wat degenereer.

options: Oogenesis starts before a girl is born; spermatogenesis starts at puberty
Spermatogenesis starts before birth; oogenesis starts at puberty
optionsAf: Oögenese begin voordat ’n meisie gebore word; spermatogenese begin by puberteit
Spermatogenese begin voor geboorte; oögenese begin by puberteit
items.explain: Oocytes form before birth; sperm production begins at puberty and continues for life.
items.explainAf: Oösiete vorm voor geboorte; spermproduksie begin by puberteit en duur lewenslank voort.

items.q: Which hormone is responsible for male secondary sexual characteristics at puberty?
items.qAf: Watter hormoon is verantwoordelik vir manlike sekondêre geslagseienskappe by puberteit?
items.explain: Testosterone causes a deeper voice, facial hair and muscle growth.
items.explainAf: Testosteroon veroorsaak ’n dieper stem, gesigshare en spiergroei.

items.q: On a menstrual-cycle hormone graph, a sharp peak of LH just before day 14 shows:
items.qAf: Op ’n menstruele-siklus-hormoongrafiek wys ’n skerp piek in LH net voor dag 14:
options: that the corpus luteum is breaking down
that ovulation is about to occur
optionsAf: dat ovulasie op die punt staan om plaas te vind

items.q: The structure that secretes progesterone after ovulation is the:
items.qAf: Die struktuur wat ná ovulasie progesteroon afskei, is die:
items.explain: The empty follicle becomes the corpus luteum, which secretes progesterone.
items.explainAf: Die leë follikel word die corpus luteum, wat progesteroon afskei.
